title: UI polish T2: complete interaction states
description: Hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, selected for every control; reduced motion tested (plan T2). Follow docs/agent-work/2026-10-25-ui-polish/PLAN.md exactly (its section for this task: Files, Interfaces, Steps, Acceptance check, Fail-first, Stop-and-ask, plus the five answered Open questions). SHOTS (8 + 2 zooms): ring 2px, square, unclipped in both themes; sidebar inset ring fully inside the row; Sort ring tight against the label, all four sides intact (not clipped); Undo/Redo visibly dimmed.
